summary: YYForce Inc., a Singapore-domiciled NASDAQ-listed (YFOR) AI-enabled workforce management and integrated facility management provider, furnished a Form 6-K dated September 22, 2026, attaching a press release and September 2026 investor deck announcing its 'YYForce 2030 Vision.' The strategy targets an integrated human, AI and robotics workforce ecosystem spanning on-demand staffing (YY Circle, Yolara AI), humanoid and service robotics under leasing and Robotics-as-a-Service models, and smart facility management via 24iFM, IoT sensors and automation. No transaction, stake, price or board recommendation is disclosed; this is a strategic-vision announcement, not a special situation, with no risk-arb angle.
